source.note: Plan wave-1 row 66 asked for a woman in a dress; none exists in reachable free packs (the only dress in this pack is the Witch tunic, whose hat brim shares the Belt material). Casual3_Female from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019, OpenGameArt) instead: long loose hair, tank top, cropped trousers; same pack, rig, clips and scale as man-casual and woman-casual, so the three read as one cast.
